question: compare average monthly attendance percentage per centre across the two years, one row per centre with both years
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre ORDER BY centre
sql_duckdb: WITH att_2023 AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, SUM("Avg Daily Present") * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM("Enrolled Kids"), 0), 0) AS avg_attendance_pct_2023 FROM "attendance_2023" GROUP BY "Centre"), att_2024 AS (SELECT "centre_name" AS centre, SUM("average_attendance") * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM("enrolment"), 0), 0) AS avg_attendance_pct_2024 FROM "attendance_2024" GROUP BY "centre_name") SELECT COALESCE(a23.centre, a24.centre) AS centre, a23.avg_attendance_pct_2023, a24.avg_attendance_pct_2024 FROM att_2023 AS a23 FULL OUTER JOIN att_2024 AS a24 ON a23.centre = a24.centre ORDER BY centre NULLS FIRST

Return SQL only. Never write files, install software, calculate values yourself, or invent columns.

A requested rate must use its stated numerator and denominator. Percentage-point change means later percentage minus earlier percentage, not relative growth.

When the user explicitly asks for percent or percentage, multiply numerator divided by denominator by 100.

CURRENT QUESTION:
compare average monthly attendance percentage per centre across the two years, one row per centre with both years
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH 
  att_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
      "Centre" AS centre,
      SUM("Avg Daily Present") * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("Enrolled Kids"), 0) AS avg_attendance_pct_2023
    FROM "attendance_2023"
    GROUP BY "Centre"
  ),
  att_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
      "centre_name" AS centre,
      SUM("average_attendance") * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("enrolment"), 0) AS avg_attendance_pct_2024
    FROM "attendance_2024"
    GROUP BY "centre_name"
  )
SELECT 
  COALESCE(a23.centre, a24.centre) AS centre,
  a23.avg_attendance_pct_2023,
  a24.avg_attendance_pct_2024
FROM att_2023 a23
FULL OUTER JOIN att_2024 a24
  ON a23.centre = a24.centre
ORDER BY centre;
```
